data.title: 海滨电车夕阳的耳塞分享
data.location: 沿海高架行驶的黄昏郊区电车
data.lighting: 大片海面夕阳金光侧逆照射
data.prompt: 1girl, solo, shiki_natsume, misty blue striped french shirt dress, thin silver-rimmed glasses, wearing one wireless earbud, reaching hand to offer second earbud toward viewer, looking slightly out window with faint shy blush, commuter train seat, wide train window, blazing golden sunset over sparkling ocean outside, hanging hand straps, strong amber window backlighting, warm orange rim light on hair and cheek, medium close-up
data.animaCaption: Reaching calmly toward you to offer the second earbud while looking out at the sunset sea, she hides a quiet blush behind her silver-rimmed glasses. Intense golden-hour glare from the coastal window rims her black hair and fills the empty commuter car with amber light.
data.promptProse: Framed tightly from the adjacent bench inside a nearly empty coastal commuter train at sunset, Shiki Natsume sits beside the wide glass window in her misty-blue striped shirt dress and thin silver glasses. Wearing one white earbud herself, she casually extends the matching earbud toward the viewer while keeping her gaze angled toward the glittering orange ocean outside so you almost miss the warm pink tint on her cheek. Blazing golden sunset light floods across the train floor and rims her dark hair and dangling overhead straps.
data.story: 沿海电车穿过一片碎金般耀眼的晚霞。夏目自己戴上一只耳机，头也不回地把另一只轻轻递到你耳边，耳尖被夕阳照得微红——「曲子太吵的话可以摘掉。只是……这首歌很配今天的晚霞。」
